name: QuintaDB
description_en:
QuintaDB combines an online database, forms, reports and customer portals for assembling a business workspace without building every interface in code. Its current site also describes AI-assisted structures that remain editable after generation. A generated blueprint is a starting point, not proof that a business process or access policy is correct.

A useful evaluation starts with a small related dataset, an explicit import key and two portal users who should see different records. This profile distinguishes shared table views from copies, ownership from ordinary fields and subscription capacity from user counts. No workspace, import, invite, automation or paid service was operated.
description_zh:
QuintaDB 将在线数据库、表单、报表和客户门户组合成业务工作区，减少逐个用代码构建界面的工作。当前网站也介绍生成后仍可编辑的 AI 辅助结构；生成蓝图只是起点，不能证明业务流程或访问策略正确。

适合用少量关联数据、明确导入键及应看到不同记录的两个门户用户进行评估。本文区分共享表视图与副本、记录归属与普通字段，以及套餐容量与用户数量；本次未操作工作区、导入、邀请、自动化或付费服务。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Filtered reports share the underlying records
sections.title_zh: 筛选报表共享底层记录
sections.en: A report is a logical view of a table, not a separate operational copy. Editing a record through one report changes the shared record seen elsewhere; a status change can remove it from the current filter. Keep one authoritative order or customer record and create purposeful views. A missing row after an edit may reflect the filter rather than deletion. Test report conditions against actual business states.
sections.zh: 报表是表的逻辑视图，不是独立业务副本。通过报表编辑记录会改变其他视图中的同一记录，状态改变也可能令其离开当前筛选。应保留唯一权威订单／客户记录并按用途建立视图。编辑后看不到某行可能源于筛选而非删除，需按真实业务状态验证条件。

sections.title_en: A repeated import needs a stable matching key
sections.title_zh: 重复导入需要稳定匹配键
sections.en: The importer maps spreadsheet columns to fields. With a chosen unique field, matching values update a record and unmatched values create one. Renamed headers that no longer match existing fields can produce extra fields. Evaluate a synthetic file containing a match, a new row and an ambiguous key; compare row totals and field mappings before accepting recurring updates. Bulk duplicate removal is a separate destructive action, not an automatic reconciliation guarantee.
sections.zh: 导入器将表格列映射到字段。选定唯一字段后，匹配值更新已有记录，未匹配值创建记录。改名后不再匹配的列头可能产生额外字段。应使用含匹配行、新行及模糊键的虚构文件评估，接受周期更新前核对行数及字段映射。批量去重是独立删除操作，并非自动对账保证。

sections.title_en: Own-record access must be enabled and ownership assigned
sections.title_zh: 仅本人记录访问需要启用并分配归属
sections.en: The portal guide explicitly makes own-record visibility an option; without it, users can see all data made available through that configuration. Imported records also need correct ownership assignment. A business email field is not automatically the portal record owner. Inspect default permissions and test both allowed and denied reads before inviting customers. Multiple portals use the same underlying application data.
sections.zh: 门户指南明确将仅本人记录可见列为选项；未启用时，用户可看到该配置开放的全部数据。导入记录也需正确分配归属，业务邮箱字段不自动等于门户记录所有者。邀请客户前应检查默认权限并测试允许及拒绝的读取；多个门户使用同一应用底层数据。

sections.title_en: Presentation filters and field access serve different purposes
sections.title_zh: 显示筛选与字段访问用途不同
sections.en: A report’s selected columns do not replace portal field permissions. The portal controls separately cover forms, visible columns and actions such as export, import or deletion. Use a representative role to check the fields and actions actually available. The documentation includes legacy account-password wording; current invitation/reset behavior requires provider confirmation and was not tested or adopted as onboarding advice.
sections.zh: 报表所选列不能替代门户字段权限。门户另控制表单、可见列及导出、导入、删除等动作。应以代表性角色检查实际开放字段及动作。文档包含旧账户密码表述，当前邀请／重置行为需向服务方确认，本次未测试，也不将该表述用作开户建议。

sections.title_en: Review generated structure and integration side effects
sections.title_zh: 审查生成结构及集成副作用
sections.en: The FAQ describes editable AI blueprints and a REST API for reading, creating and updating data. It also gives examples of status transitions and external notifications. These are documented capabilities and examples, not observed successful workflows. Before connecting a real system, define the trigger, target record and expected output, then test invalid input and repeated delivery with non-sensitive sample data. API coverage and credentials remain account-specific.
sections.zh: FAQ 介绍可编辑 AI 蓝图，以及读取、新建、更新数据的 REST API，也给出状态流转及外部通知示例。这些是文档能力与示例，不是已观察到的成功流程。连接真实系统前应明确触发、目标记录及预期输出，再用非敏感样本测试无效输入与重复投递。API 覆盖及凭据仍需按账户核对。

sections.title_en: Shared capacity includes data that remains stored
sections.title_zh: 共享容量包含持续存储的数据
sections.en: Pricing uses compute units shared by operations, structure, records and files, rather than a simple per-seat or per-row price. The continuing Free tier is single-person with 10,000 monthly units; a new-account trial supplies 50,000 units for fourteen days. Paid team/client users are described as unlimited within capacity. Review retained attachments and activity together: low request volume alone does not imply low unit consumption.
sections.zh: 定价使用操作、结构、记录及文件共享的计算单位，不是简单按席位或行收费。持续 Free 为单人、每月一万单位，新账户试用为十四天五万单位。付费团队／客户用户在容量内描述为不限人数。需一起评估保留附件与活动量，低请求量不必然意味着低单位消耗。

sections.title_en: Trial expiry can pause public access without deleting data
sections.title_zh: 试用到期可能暂停公开访问而不删除数据
sections.en: The pricing page says units reset on the first calendar day and exhausted active workloads may pause. After an unpaid trial, an over-capacity account falls back to Free with data retained, but portals and public forms may pause for other users. Displayed paid examples start at €25/month for 150,000 units; assisted building is a separate offer. Do not promise uninterrupted customer access from a successful trial alone.
sections.zh: 定价页称单位在每月首日重置，耗尽后的活动负载可能暂停。未付费试用结束后退回 Free、保留数据，但超容量时门户及公开表单可能对其他用户暂停。显示付费示例从每月 €25／十五万单位起，协助搭建另有方案。不能仅因试用成功就承诺客户持续访问。
